1. Select Debug settings above and enable USB debugging. Enable network debugging too, if available.

2. Return to this app and check port 5555. Change the check port if your firmware uses another one.

3. Connect both devices to the same local network. Install ADB on the computer, run the displayed command, then run adb devices. Android phones need an ADB client.

4. If an RSA authorization prompt appears on the TV, choose Allow. unauthorized means approval is still needed.

5. If network ADB is never detected, the firmware may support USB debugging only. A normal APK cannot enable system network ADB. A working USB ADB connection with adb tcpip 5555, or firmware support, is required.

A local check does not prove access from another device. Check guest Wi-Fi, AP isolation and firewalls. An existing ADB connection may prevent new checks. Turn off debugging in system settings when finished.
